purpose: Teacher-forced decode validation of the SONIC token->pose pipeline on the cluster (no physics). Corroborates GATE 0.5 with stronger numbers.
method: Feed RECORDED proprio (robot_q_current joints, observation.state.joint_velocity, imu_torso_gyroscope, imu_torso_quaternion->projected gravity, previous action.robot_q_desired as last_action) + ground-truth action.token_state through gear_sonic_deploy/policy/release/model_decoder.onnx (994->29), then compare q_target = default + decoder_output against the recorded action.robot_q_desired.

gate05_comparison.note: This run reproduces the recorded commanded motion (robot_q_desired) far better than GATE 0.5's offline proxy because the joint permutation, obs order (deploy angvel-first), quaternion conventions, default pose and implicit-actuator gains were all nailed from the repo. Confirms the latent/token path is correct.

confirmed_fidelity_params.decoder_obs_994_layout: token(64) | base_ang_vel(3) | joint_pos_rel(29) | joint_vel(29) | last_actions(29) | gravity_dir(3), each non-token term with 10-frame history (oldest-first), all 29-dim terms in IsaacLab order, no obs scales
confirmed_fidelity_params.decoder_obs_order_source: gear_sonic_deploy/policy/release/observation_config.yaml (deploy order); NOTE this differs from sonic_release/config.yaml actor 'policy' group order (gravity-first) which does NOT reproduce the demo

quaternion_conventions.evidence: robot_q_current[0][3]=-0.997 (w-first, upright); xyzw interpretation flips the robot (ncon=0, free-fall)

default_joint_pos_named.source: gear_sonic/envs/manager_env/robots/g1.py init_state.joint_pos; use_default_offset=true -> q_target = default + decoder_output

closed_loop_physics_verdict.detail: A hand-rolled MuJoCo explicit-torque PD loop cannot reproduce the IsaacLab-trained decoder's active balance: the G1 falls within ~0.5-1s even on GT tokens, across all configs tried (deploy MOTOR_KP/KD and training implicit gains, 3x/6x stiffness, implicit dof_damping, implicitfast integrator, both obs/history orders, both quat conventions, training/deploy default). Feet contact verified correct (ncon=4, wxyz init). This is the IsaacLab(implicit-actuator)->MuJoCo(explicit-PD) sim2sim gap.
closed_loop_physics_verdict.isaac_sim_on_cluster: NOT_FEASIBLE (Isaac Sim 5.1 RTX/Vulkan ERROR_DEVICE_LOST at SimulationApp startup on headless H100; needs root)
closed_loop_physics_verdict.recommendation: Closed-loop executed §4 (EE/wrist error, no-fall rate, root roll/pitch, RG/R0/R1 videos) stays the 5090 job (results/eval_on_5090_runbook.md), reusing the confirmed_fidelity_params above.

provenance.env: sonic conda env, CPU only (no training GPUs touched)
